scenarios.name: Open and closes an empty browser search while editing a sketch

scenario_steps.name: a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited
the model browser is visible with its search field closed
the user selects the browser search control
an empty search field appears beneath the browser header
the model browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible
the user selects the close control on the empty search field
the browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible
